description: This trail loops up and back down the northwest facing slope along Bobtail (Naltesby) Lake providing two spectactular viewpoints along the way. The trail begins and ends at the Bobtail Lake Recreation Site. Parking is available at site 2 (middle campsite) where one end of the trail is located. The other end of the trail is near Site 1 and is only ~400m away.
directions: Travel 9kms west of Prince George from hwy 97/16 junction - turn left on to the Blackwater Rd - proceed 21kms then turn right on to the Pelican FSR. At 35.5km turn right on to the Bobtail FSR (Telegraph trail). The trail is at 16km.
title: Bobtail Bluff Trail
